question.text: A body of mass $2 \mathrm{~kg}$ is placed on a horizontal surface having kinetic friction 0.4 and static friction $0.5 .$ If the force applied on the body is $2.5 \mathrm{~N},$ then the frictional force acting on the body will be $\left[\mathrm{g}=10 \mathrm{~ms}^{-2}\right]$

solution.text:
Limiting friction $=0.5 \times 2 \times 10=10 \mathrm{~N}$

The applied force is less than force of friction, therefore the force of friction is equal to the applied force.
